lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 14 distinct white vertical line segments are visible across the lateral torso; spacing is relatively uniform with a slight decrease in interval distance toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 9 (counting anterior to posterior) exhibits a clear central vertical gap; lines 1, 12, 13, and 14 are abbreviated segments that do not intersect the dorsal or ventral boundaries of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three distinct high-contrast white spots are located on the lower posterior haunch; the grouping consists of one larger superior spot and two smaller inferior spots.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white chevron on the nasal bridge; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek; a transverse white band on the lower ventral neck; white patches on the internal distal limbs and above the hooves.
